Statistics Midterm
Name: ____________

Section I: Multiple Choice (2 points each)
1. The mean of 4, 8, 12 is
A. 6
B. 8
C. 10
D. 12

2. The median of 3, 9, 1, 7, 5 is
A. 3
B. 5
C. 7
D. 9

Section II: Free Response
3. A data set has values 2, 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 7, 9. (6 points)
(a) Find the mean. (2 points)
(b) Find the median. (2 points)
(c) Explain whether the data is skewed. (2 points)

Answer Key
1. B
2. B
3. (a) 5 (b) 4.5 (c) Rubric: mentions right skew
